title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Providing Training Courses for Administrative Staff

description.narrative: Raise the efficiency of administrative staff who have not received specialized administrative training, through the following training courses: 1) Professional Project Management, 2) Human Resources Management, 3) Strategic Planning, 4) Financial Leaders Preparation. Develop the administrative skills of trainee beneficiaries and link them to suitable job opportunities in the local labor market.

Raising the efficiency of administrative staff through specialized training courses in leadership and management fields, such as project management, human resources, and strategic planning, to support non-profit organizations and qualify young people for the labor market.
